coverage.value: World Wide New Testament Baptist Missions — wwntbm.com
coverage.detail: HIT. Static WordPress per-person giving pages at wwntbm.com/connect/missionaries/<first1>-and-<first2>-<surname>/ ; each page carries the couple's field, ministry focus, contact details and donation options. Index is a paginated archive (/connect/missionaries/page/N/, at least 10 pages seen), so the roster is materially larger than what 14 search queries surfaced. Best-yield shape in this segment; a fetch-enabled pass over the 10+ archive pages should exhaust it.

MISS. No per-person missionary pages surfaced. Site exposes /about-us/leadership-team/, /explore/jobs-at-fim/<role>/, /explore/resources/, /go/internships/. No /missionaries/ path indexed at all; giving appears not to be per-person-crawlable.

coverage.value: Continental Baptist Missions — probed wrong domain cbmin.org
coverage.detail: MISS / bad probe. cbmin.org is Canadian Baptist Ministries (a CBF-aligned denominational board), not Continental Baptist Missions. Its surface is /africa/, /project/<name>/, /prayerline/ — project and region pages, no per-person giving pages. Continental Baptist Missions' real domain (likely continentalbaptist.net) was NOT tested — leave it open for a future wave.

MISS. Flat static .html site: /our-standards.html, /our-purpose.html, /biblical-principles.html, /baltimore.html, /testimonials.html. Pages are keyed by church-plant LOCATION, not by person; no missionary roster and no per-person giving page indexed. Sister site bcpmsource.org has the same shape. Separately, bcpusa.org (Baptist Church Planters, a different agency) surfaced and was NOT probed.
Not probed — MWBM is on the BRIEF's already-worked list, so no budget was spent on it despite its appearance in the segment candidate list.
Mostly repeats; two new families (Adams, Blumer). No Caribbean field label confirmed in snippets.
Returned only index/FAQ/contact pages. Snippet mentioned a 'Gates family' in Dearborn, Michigan but no profile URL was cited, so no record was emitted.
Zero WWNTBM profile URLs; results were Wikipedia diplomatic-mission noise. Spanish South America appears thin or absent at this agency.
All repeats of the Western-Europe set (Bonikowsky, Klaus, Bergman, Kendrick, Sanchez). No Eastern Europe field surfaced.
Role-based qualifier failed — one repeat (Shaw) plus Wikipedia Bible-college noise. Region qualifiers work on this site; role qualifiers do not.
Exclusion sweep — highly productive, 5 new families (Stelzig, Racke, Prater, Preston, Wyrick).
Second exclusion sweep — 4 new (Zimmer, Hurst, Gilliam, Johnston). Still producing new names when budget ran out; the seam is NOT exhausted.

needs_review.issue: Seam not exhausted — budget ran out while still producing
needs_review.finding: WWNTBM's archive is paginated to at least /connect/missionaries/page/10/. Both final exclusion sweeps returned new families, so search-result skimming has not bottomed out the roster.
needs_review.evidence: https://wwntbm.com/connect/missionaries/page/10/ and https://wwntbm.com/connect/missionaries/page/8/ both indexed; 9 previously-unseen families appeared in the last two queries.
needs_review.recommendation: Re-dispatch WWNTBM as a normal enumerate-one-agency assignment, or fetch the 10+ archive pages directly. Rotate exclusion sweeps rather than region qualifiers — regions are now largely mined, exclusions are not.

needs_review.issue: Widowed-slug pages: spouse named in slug but deceased
needs_review.finding: Two pages pair two first names in the slug while the title and snippet name only one living missionary: /elwood-and-doris-hurst/ (Doris Hurst died April 2024 per the agency's own note) and /norman-and-joy-johnston/ (Norman Johnston died May 2018).
needs_review.recommendation: Only the living missionary was emitted from each. Flagging because a naive slug-splitter on this domain would emit two deceased people as prospects.

needs_review.issue: Unverified roster mention with no citable page
needs_review.finding: A snippet referenced a 'Gates family' ministering to Arabs in Dearborn, Michigan under WWNTBM, but no profile URL was returned and no first names were given.
needs_review.evidence: Snippet on the 'North America' query; source page not cited.
needs_review.recommendation: Do not emit. A fetch-enabled pass should check for a /connect/missionaries/<first>-and-<first>-gates/ page.

needs_review.issue: Segment candidates left untested by budget
needs_review.finding: Evangelical Baptist Missions, Baptist Bible Fellowship International, Independent Faith Mission, Bible Baptist Missions, Baptist Church Planters (bcpusa.org) and the real Continental Baptist Missions domain were never probed — discovery stopped at search 4 because WWNTBM hit.
needs_review.evidence: Only 4 of the 9 named candidate agencies were surveyed before the brief's 'stop surveying and mine it' rule took effect.
needs_review.recommendation: A follow-on discovery-only pass on this segment is likely to be cheap and productive; the independent-Baptist archetype is clearly still producing static per-person pages in 2026.
